sentence: In the corpus's benchmark result, growth from AI investment concentrates among the ex-ante larger firms and pushes industry concentration upward
passage: [Babina et al. (2024), p. 1] "AI-powered growth concentrates among larger firms and is associated with higher industry concentration."

gemini.note: The sentence introduces 'ex-ante' and claims causation ('pushes') for industry concentration, whereas the passage only states an association with 'larger firms'.
